text:
elaine.growth: FYI, spike after Tuesday webinar. ~1.8% of leads never hit RR claimers when enrichment lags. noticing more manual claims.
jamal.ops: thanks for flagging. do we have a repro? is this the same fallback-to-failqueue behaviour we've seen before? :mag: 
elaine.growth: repro is consistent: HS webhook posts -> enrich service can take up to 10s -> router TTL=4s so it moves lead to FallbackQueue, but SDR claim workers only poll RR. leads sit for 20-40m until backfill job moves them.
sara.marketing: that's causing SDR churn. can we do a short-term "heartbeat gateway" that retains leads for a minute and prefers enriched records? low-friction toggle in HS workflows recommended.
mike.salesops: operational plan: 1) HubSpot forward to GatewayQueue with property gateway_hold=true 2) Router polls GatewayQueue and prefers leads with property enrich_done=true 3) After max_hold (60s) return to normal RR with an "enrich_missing" flag for SDRs to triage
jamal.ops: engineering note: instead of long-lived hold, add heartbeat probe to enrichment svc. if enrich endpoint responds with 202+progress header, bump router TTL by small amount. this avoids moving to failqueue prematurely.
olivia.eng: I can ship router-side change today: add GatewayQueue consumer + heartbeat check. proposed rule: if lead.enrich_status != "done" then mark hold_until = now + 60s and re-enqueue check every 5s. fallback to RR after hold expires. will open PR on routing-service.
andrew.sdr: for SDRs: can we tag gateway leads so they don't accidentally claim half-enriched records? maybe auto-assign owner=unassigned and hide from immediate inbox.
mike.salesops: yes, we'll add `lead_property: gateway_hold=true` and `owner=unassigned`. Also a daily digest for any gateway leads > 10m.
jamal.ops: metrics to add: gauge gateway_queue_depth, histogram enrichment_wait_ms, alert if >1% of daily leads exceed 60s hold. also add a burn-in dashboard showing manual_claims_per_hour.
elaine.growth: nice. marketing wants this before Friday's campaign push. can we aim for a canary tomorrow morning?
olivia.eng: plan: PR now -> review -> canary deploy 11:00 PT tomorrow. will include feature flag. snippet of webhook payload we'd need from HS: 
```json
{
  "event": "contact.created",
  "lead_id": "12345",
  "gateway_hold": "true",
  "enrich_status": "pending",
  "received_at": "2025-11-04T15:23:01Z"
}
```
jamal.ops: and hubspot workflow change: set `enrich_status=done` on enrich completion and call `/router/webhook` to re-submit. mike, can you own the HS workflow edit?
mike.salesops: will do. I'll draft the workflow and test on sandbox HS account. also adding rule: if enrich returns error -> set `enrich_status=failed` and route to manual triage queue.
sara.marketing: add a note to launch playbook: "Gateway hold may delay assignment up to 60s; SDRs should not manually claim unless lead has enrich_status=done or >10m in gateway."
lead-router-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-gateway-v2 by olivia.eng -> canary queued. :rocket:
andrew.sdr: thanks, that will cut our manual work. ping me when digest enabled.
elaine.growth: thanks team. after canary let's monitor: - percent leads held - percent leads returned to RR after enrichment - manual claims delta. will sync post-canary in #marketing. :white_check_mark:
